name: A carter's wagon
notes: The shared wagon caravan: a trader walking at his horse's head, a cart behind, two hired guards. Region tables set it on their own roads in `caravans`.

talk.say: Whoa, there. You buying, or just looking at my horse?
Keep your hands where the carter can see them and we'll all get on.

consequence.notice: The carter's guild will hear of this.
consequence.killing_notice: A carter's man is dead on the road, and the Tallymen keep count.

rescue.say: They'd have had the lot. Here -- it's not much, but it's yours, and you'll get a fair price from me any day.

name: A pack-trader
notes: The shared packhorse caravan: a trader leading one loaded horse, one guard.

talk.say: Needles, thread, salt and news. The news is free.
Road's been quiet. I'd like it to stay that way.

consequence.notice: The Tallymen will hear a pack-trader was set on.
consequence.killing_notice: A pack-trader's guard lies dead on the road.

rescue.say: I owe you the horse, and the horse owes you his load. Take this.

talk.say: Mind the bends further on. And if you see smoke off the road, it's not a charcoal-burner.

hook.rumour: The Warden says there has been trouble near {place}.

consequence.notice: You struck a Warden. The Roll will have your name.
consequence.killing_notice: A Warden is dead by your hand.

talk.say: We walk to the stones and back again, every year. Walk a way with us, if you like. There's a shrine not far off the road that nobody visits any more.

hook.rumour: The pilgrims speak of {place}, off the road.

talk.say: I've walked this road twice and I'm no nearer {place} than I was at noon. Would you see me there? I can pay.
talk.thanks: There -- I can see the roofs. Thank you. Here, as I said.

talk.say: Put your back into it -- there! That's the wheel on. I'd have been here till dark. Take a loaf, and my thanks.
Things you won't find in a town, friend. Towns are where things go to be ordinary.
You never saw me. Here -- it's all I've got. There's a place off the road where nobody looks.

talk.prompt: Point the hunters after the runaway
talk.say: Obliged. There's a share of the writ in it for you.
